mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_gi_lookup(food_id, food_name, category_code, status, next_attempt_at) SELECT f.id, f.food_name, f.category_code, 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM food_nutrition f LEFT JOIN food_gi_lookup g ON g.food_id = f.id WHERE f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.gi_value IS NULL AND (g.food_id IS NULL OR g.food_name != f.food_name OR COALESCE(g.category_code, 0) != COALESCE(f.category_code, 0)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE food_name = VALUES(food_name), category_code = VALUES(category_code), status = 'PENDING', next_attempt_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lease_token = NULL, gi_value = NULL, reference_food = NULL, source_url = NULL, note = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT g.food_id, g.food_name, g.category_code FROM food_gi_lookup g JOIN food_nutrition f ON f.id = g.food_id WHERE f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.gi_value IS NULL AND g.food_name = f.food_name AND COALESCE(g.category_code, 0) = COALESCE(f.category_code, 0) AND g.next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY g.next_attempt_at, g.food_id LIMIT 3
SELECT status, gi_value, reference_food, source_url, note FROM food_gi_reference WHERE food_name = #{name} AND category_code = #{category} AND enabled = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE food_gi_lookup SET lease_token = #{lease}, status = 'LOOKING_UP', next_attempt_at = TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, 10, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE food_id = #{item.foodId} AND food_name = #{item.foodName} AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE food_gi_lookup SET status = #{result.status}, gi_value = #{result.value}, reference_food = #{result.referenceFood}, source_url = #{result.sourceUrl}, note = #{result.note}, checked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lease_token = NULL, next_attempt_at = TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, CASE WHEN #{result.status} = 'RETRY' THEN 1 ELSE 7 END, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE food_id = #{item.foodId} AND lease_token = #{lease}
